cards.text: Barnabas and Saul are back from their mission to Jerusalem (Acts 12:25), and now we're in the church at Antioch, friend. Its prophets and teachers are Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen and Saul. Five names on the team, and one of them grew up with somebody you would NOT expect.

cards.question: Manaen, one of the prophets and teachers at Antioch, had been brought up with ___ the tetrarch.

cards.text: While they're worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit says to set apart two of those five names for the work He has called them to. Two. Out of five.

cards.question: The Holy Spirit says to set apart two of the five prophets and teachers at Antioch. Which two?
After fasting and prayer in the church at Antioch, what happens to Barnabas and Saul before they're sent off?

answers.text: They are given letters to carry

cards.text: Sent out by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul go down to Seleucia and set sail from there. Me? Before I came here, the farthest I'd ever traveled was across the Millers' kitchen and into the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: From Seleucia, Barnabas and Saul sail to the island of ___.

cards.text: They arrive at Salamis, and John, also called Mark (Acts 12:25), is with them as their helper. Every job goes better with an extra set of hands, and I'd know, because I've been using a MUSTACHE for mine.

cards.question: In Salamis, Barnabas and Saul proclaim the word of God in the Jewish ___.

cards.text: They travel through the whole island as far as Paphos, and there they find a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus. Sorcerer AND false prophet, friend. That's two titles on one business card, and I wouldn't let either one near my ovens.

cards.question: Bar-Jesus is an attendant of the proconsul Sergius Paulus, a man of intelligence. Why does the proconsul call for Barnabas and Saul?

answers.text: He wants to hear the word of God
He wants them off his island
He wants them put under arrest

cards.text: Now the text calls the sorcerer Elymas, because that's what his name means. And he's about to get in the way.

cards.question: Elymas the sorcerer opposes Barnabas and Saul. What does he try to do?

answers.text: Turn the proconsul from the faith
Get Barnabas and Saul thrown in prison
Drive Barnabas and Saul off the island

cards.text: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looks right at Elymas. It's the kind of look that makes a grown man put his phone DOWN.

Paul doesn't hold back, calling Elymas a child of the devil and an enemy of all righteousness, full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. I've had an oven timer yell at me for ten straight minutes, and it NEVER got that specific.

cards.question: Paul tells Elymas the sorcerer that the blindness coming on him will last forever.

cards.text: Paul tells Elymas the hand of the Lord is against him, and for a time he will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun. Immediately, mist and darkness come over him.

cards.question: Mist and darkness come over Elymas the sorcerer. What does he do?

answers.text: He gropes around for someone to lead him
He begs Paul to take back his words
He tries to run away from Paul

cards.question: After the proconsul Sergius Paulus sees what happened to Elymas, he believes.

cards.text: Sergius Paulus is astonished at the teaching about the Lord. But don't get comfortable, friend, because this story is far from over.
